title: Comprehension Against the Heavens
author: Hunmeng
description: In 2026, eighteen-year-old Ye Xuan dies saving a child in Hangzhou and awakens in New York, in a world of Awakened powers. Broke and entangled in the investigation of a missing technician, he discovers a gift: when he finishes studying a book, its knowledge becomes clear in an instant. He can make his own discoveries, but understanding is not the same as power. His missing older brother remains a mystery, and the road toward the Great Dao has only begun.
